title: Ember Vigil
tagline: Keep your lantern lit and survive the winter night.
summary: A survival roguelite in a dark Nordic forest. You move, your rune weapons fire by themselves, and dawn is seven minutes away.
about: Monsters pour out of the winter forest and you have one job: keep your lantern burning until dawn. You only steer. Your weapons fire on their own, so every decision is where to stand and which upgrade to take next.

Collect blue crystals to level up and build your own mix of burning bolts, a ring of embers, firepots, Tyr's spear and northern lights that chain between enemies. Max out a weapon, pair it with the right blessing and open a chest to evolve it into something far stronger.

Every run earns embers, even when you fall. Spend them on permanent upgrades and new heroes, then head back out and last a little longer. Survive a night to unlock the next one. There are ten, each harder than the last.
features: 3 bosses, from a fell troll to the Frost Giant

title: Snowfeud
tagline: Penguin artillery. Beat the bot, or duel a friend over a link.
summary: Two penguin teams, two snowy hills and a mountain in between. Drag back, mind the wind and bury the other side in snow.
about: Two teams of penguins face each other across the snow with a mountain in the way. Drag back to aim, let go to throw, and read the wind before every shot. Bury the whole enemy team to win.
Play the bot and work your way through three rivals: The Rookie, The Pro and The Legend. Your first match unlocks six special weapons, walking and switching penguins.
Or challenge a friend. Take your shot, send the link, and they fire back from their own phone. There are no accounts and nothing to install. The whole match travels inside the link.
features: Three bot rivals to beat in order
Friend duels played over shared links
controls: Drag back with the mouse, release

title: GolfFeud
tagline: Play a hole, send the link, and your friend chases your ghost.
summary: Nine-hole golf duels. Pick a club, drag back to swing and add backspin or topspin to stop it on the green.
about: GolfFeud is golf you play against a ghost. Play a hole, send the link, and your friend plays the same hole with your round replaying beside them, shot for shot. Fewest strokes takes the hole. Nine holes settle the feud.
Choose between driver, iron, wedge and putter, then drag back anywhere to swing. Backspin bites on landing and topspin runs. Mind the wind, the water, the sand and the rough.
No friend around? Play the bot. The Rookie, The Pro and The Legend each play a full nine-hole match against you.
features: 9-hole matches with fresh holes every round
controls: Drag back with the mouse, release

title: Ålandsflyg
tagline: Fly bush planes, airliners and an air ambulance over the real Åland.
summary: A flight simulator over Åland and the Stockholm and Turku archipelagos, built from real satellite and elevation data.
about: Take off from Mariehamn and fly over the real Åland: forests, fields, bare rock, lakes and towns from satellite data, terrain from elevation models, and every road, building and lighthouse from OpenStreetMap. The map reaches all the way to Stockholm and Turku.

Choose between five aircraft: a bush plane on wheels, a seaplane on floats, a twin turboprop, an airliner with fly-by-wire and a yellow air ambulance helicopter. Eight missions include medevac flights as far out as Kökar.
New to flying? The first flight walks you through takeoff, turns and landing. A landing guide shows the glide path and the speed to hold, and every touchdown gets up to three stars.

Real airports: Mariehamn, Arlanda, Bromma, Turku
Weather, clouds and six times of day

title: ICE FLOE
tagline: Drop, merge and chase the Midnight Sun. A new puzzle every day.
summary: A daily merge puzzle with real physics. Drop ice into the fjord, merge matching pieces and reach the Midnight Sun before it overflows.
about: Drop pieces of ice into the fjord. When two matching pieces touch they merge into the next size up, from a tiny snowflake all the way to the Midnight Sun. The pieces tumble, roll and settle for real, so every drop shifts the whole pile.

Chain merges quickly to build a combo multiplier. Let the ice rest above the dashed line for too long and the run is over. Once you reach the Midnight Sun it stays on the board and keeps glowing, so the fjord fills up faster.
Every day there is a new puzzle with the same pieces for everyone. Share your result and compare with friends, keep your daily streak alive, or play Endless mode for new pieces every round.
features: A new daily puzzle, the same for everyone
8 pieces from Snowflake to Midnight Sun

title: Putt Cove
tagline: Nine holes of island mini golf with windmills, bumpers and portals.
summary: Mini golf on a sunny island course. Bank shots off the rails, time the windmill, dodge the water and sink every putt in as few strokes as you can.
about: Nine handmade holes on a little island course, each with its own trick: a dogleg to bank around, a sand trap that eats your speed, a bumper alley, a spinning windmill, a lagoon in the middle of the fairway, tide slopes that push the ball sideways, a portal that jumps you across the water and a long S-shaped finale.
Drag back from anywhere to aim and set the power, then let go to putt. Water costs a stroke and puts the ball back where you hit from. Sink it in one for a hole in one.
Play alone for your best round, or take turns with a friend on the same device and compare scorecards at the end.

Windmill, bumpers, slopes, sand, water and portals
Scorecard with birdies, eagles and holes in one
2 players take turns on one device

title: Dart Night
tagline: Steady your hand and count down from 301. Beat three bar rivals.
summary: Classic 301 darts in a cosy pub. Hold to steady your aim, let go to throw, and finish on a double before your rival does.
about: Three darts a turn, 301 to count down, and you have to land exactly on zero. The board is regulation size and every segment scores like the real thing: trebles, doubles, the 25 and the bullseye.
Press and hold to steady your hand. Hold too long and it starts to shake, so pick your moment and let go. When a finish is possible the game shows you the checkout, like T20 · T20 · D20.
Work through three rivals, The Rookie, The Pro and The Legend, play a friend on the same device, or practise Around the Clock and race from 1 to the bull in as few darts as possible.

title: Longshot
tagline: Draw, read the wind and find the gold from 18 to 70 metres.
summary: Archery at sunset. Drag back to draw the bow, set the angle and let fly. Six ends with changing wind and a new daily range every day.
about: Six ends of three arrows each, from 18 metres out to 70. Drag back to draw the bow: the length of the pull sets the power and the direction sets the angle. A short guide shows the first part of the flight, the rest is up to you.

Watch the wind sock and the flag on the target. A tailwind carries the arrow higher, a headwind makes it drop. The camera follows every arrow all the way to the boss and shows you exactly where it landed.
Shoot the daily range with the same wind as everyone else and share your result, take a free round, or duel a friend arrow by arrow on the same device.
features: Daily range with a streak and shareable result
controls: ↑ ↓ for angle, hold Space to draw
